svg.title: What Smart Home for AgentBuff does
svg.desc: Device control: Switch, dim and recolor lights, set air conditioner mode and temperature, and control several devices in one call. Confirmation for risky devices: Heaters, kettles, coffee machines, garage doors and water valves only act after an explicit confirmation. Scenes: Save a group of device states as a scene and run it with one sentence. Scenes are stored on our side. Schedules and timers: Create schedules and timers that a background worker runs, then list, pause or cancel them from chat. Event automations: React to a door opening, motion or a temperature threshold, and take a camera photo as part of the action. Infrared AC pairing: Pair an infrared air conditioner from an open code library, SmartIR (MIT), converted for this app. Encrypted key storage: The Tuya key is encrypted with AES-256-GCM, and MCP tokens are stored only as hashes. Sign in with AgentBuff: Login and entitlement come from AgentBuff, and the agent connects to the app automatically after purchase.
svg.text: The parts of Smart Home for AgentBuff people use every day.
